raw.rationale: This is likely a dopamine D2/CHRM3 antagonist such as metoclopramide or a related antiemetic, which lacks a broad cytotoxic mechanism and is not known to be selectively lethal to any cancer lineage in PRISM; selectivity at 2.5 µM is therefore expected to be rare and near baseline. Published PRISM/CTRP data for similar launched dopamine antagonists show no lineage with reproducible selective killing, so probabilities are set at or below the stated base rate.
